Commentary.Commentary: The match officials are out in the middle, followed by the India Women's players. Shathi Rani and Shamima Sultana are the two openers for Bangladesh Women. Pooja Vastrakar will bowl the first over.
...RUN CHASE...

For the hosts, the bowlers were outstanding and were well-backed by the fielders as well. Salma Khatun took 3 wickets and was the pick of the bowlers. Fahima Khatun bowled well too as she scalped a couple while others chipped in with a wicket each too. The target is not a big one but the Indian bowling lineup holds the firepower to defend this. Let's see what happens ahead with the run chase coming soon.

A good finish to the innings for India Women but this is still a below-par total! The game started on a positive note for the visitors but a cluster of wickets starting from the 5th over got them on the back foot. Both the openers along with skipper Harmanpreet Kaur and wicket-keeper Yastika Bhatia lost their wickets in a bundle that restricted the flow of runs. The spinners dominated the middle phase as they gave away just 28 runs from over 7th to 15th picking up three wickets in the meantime. Jemimah Rodrigues and Harleen Deol struggled to even rotate the strike in the middle phase which led India Women to this low total.
An innings of struggle for India Women comes to an end as We are at the halfway stage of the game with India Women managing to score 95 for the loss of 8 wickets in their 20 overs.
Short and wid of off, Pooja Vastrakar lofts this over mid off for a couple to close the India Women innings at 95 for 8.

Commentary.Commentary: The match is set to begin. Bangladesh Women players are huddled for some last-moment words from the skipper. Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana walk out to open for India Women. Marufa Akter will start with the new ball for Bangladesh Women. Here we go...

Nigar Sultana, the captain of Bangladesh Women, says they would look to restrict them to a total below 130 as they have planned accordingly for a string side. Adds that Fahima Khatun comes in for Salma Khatun. Mentions that the way the debutant batted in the last game was a big boost for the side because of her hard work towards the game.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the skipper of India Women, says they will bat first. Says that the track is the same and feels that in the second inning, the ball would turn a lot so they would want to set a total. Mentions that they would aim for at least 150 on this track and above anything would be an advantage to them.

India Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Shafali Verma, Smriti Mandhana, Jemimah Rodrigues, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Yastika Bhatia (WK), Harleen Deol, Pooja Vastrakar, Deepti Sharma, Amanjot Kaur, Bareddy Anusha, Minnu Mani.

Bangladesh Women (Playing XI) - Shathi Rani, Shamima Sultana, Sobhana Mostary, Nigar Sultana (C/WK), Shorna Akter, Ritu Moni, Nahida Akter, Marufa Akter, Fahima Khatun (In for Salma Khatun), Sultana Khatun, Rabeya Khan.
TOSS - The two captains are out in the middle. The coin toss lands in the favour of Harmanpreet Kaur and India have opted to BAT first.

India Women were rock solid as they were pitch perfect against the hosts in the first game and would be looking to continue the winning momentum and seal the series win with a victory today. In the first game, Shafali Verma and Jemimah Rodrigues missed out with the bat and would look to make up for it while Skipper Harmanpreet Kaur was good with her half-century that saw the team home. The key battle would be between the batters of India Women against the bowlers of Bangladesh Women. Stay tuned for toss and team updates...

Bangladesh Women are on a learning curve at the moment on the international circuit and the first game was a reflection of it for them. The side did well in the first powerplay but then lost their way in the middle muddle which left them with a below-par score. In this game, the team would want to forget about the batting vows and would want to bat well in the middle phase with rotating the strike being the base of it.

Hello and welcome to all our viewers as we build up for the 2nd game of the 3-match T20I series between Bangladesh Women and India Women. Shere Bangla National Stadium, Mirpur, Dhaka will host this game too.
